_comment: FICTIONAL — created for demonstration. Two consecutive quarterly submissions from the same borrower. Between them the borrower renames the earnings line: `ebitda` becomes `adjusted_ebitda`. Everything else keeps its name. A value-only pipeline cannot see this; a pipeline that remembers last quarter's field map can.
